change_reason: V1 recovered both directed bridges but failed prediction gates because a hidden cause directly loaded bridge target C, while only cross-chart bridge coefficients—not local mechanisms or the latent state—were intervention-identified. V2 narrows the minimal claim by removing direct hidden loading from bridge targets. It also uses fresh seeds, corrects the permuted-label negative-control implementation, and treats the strongest observation-only selector as a non-inferiority comparator when it recovers the same graph.

overrides.hypothesis: When hidden-cause shift is confined to a noncausal contact pair, a discrete Laplace-Beltrami fold-contact prior plus randomized paired interventions will reject the contact confounder, orient the invariant sparse bridges, and match the strongest correct observation-only predictor while outperforming local, raw-association, and dense observational baselines.
overrides.claim_boundary: This is a four-chart synthetic bridge-identification gate. V2 intentionally does not solve hidden-state estimation or direct latent confounding of a bridge target. Geometry proposes candidates only; randomized interventions orient them. No cortical, U-fiber, neural, biological, or AGI mechanism is established.
